# NovaFlow NF-Series Product Manual

> Fictional demo manual. Revision 1.2, July 2026.

## 1. Product overview

The NovaFlow NF-Series consists of two industrial liquid-transfer pump models: NF-200 and NF-500. Both models are designed for non-potable, non-flammable industrial liquids within the operating limits stated in this manual.

## 2. NF-200 specifications

| Item | Specification |
|---|---|
| Maximum flow | 120 litres per minute |
| Rated voltage | 220–240 V AC, single phase |
| Operating temperature | -10°C to 45°C |
| Ingress protection | IP65 |
| Maximum continuous run time | 8 hours, followed by a 30-minute cooling period |
| Limited warranty | 24 months from shipment date |

The NF-200 must not be operated dry. The inlet line must be primed before startup.

## 3. NF-500 specifications

| Item | Specification |
|---|---|
| Maximum flow | 300 litres per minute |
| Rated voltage | 380–415 V AC, three phase |
| Operating temperature | -20°C to 55°C |
| Ingress protection | IP67 |
| Maximum continuous run time | Continuous duty within rated conditions |
| Limited warranty | 36 months from shipment date |

The NF-500 must be installed by qualified personnel and must use the protective devices required by local electrical codes.

## 4. Fluids and prohibited environments

NF-Series pumps are intended for compatible industrial liquids. They are not approved for:

- potable or drinking-water systems;
- gasoline, solvents or other flammable liquids;
- explosive atmospheres;
- fluids outside the listed temperature range;
- applications requiring sanitary or food-grade certification.

## 5. Installation

Before installation:

1. Confirm the model and rated voltage on the nameplate.
2. Verify that the supply voltage matches the nameplate.
3. Inspect the pump and packaging for shipping damage.
4. Confirm that the inlet is primed and that valves are correctly positioned.
5. Install the required electrical protection.

Do not bypass electrical protection. Do not modify the housing or control wiring.

## 6. Basic troubleshooting

### Pump does not start

- Confirm that power is available.
- Confirm the supply voltage matches the nameplate.
- Check the approved external breaker or protective device.
- If there is smoke, an electrical smell or visible damage, disconnect power only when it is safe to do so and contact qualified service personnel.

### Flow is lower than expected

- Check for an obstructed inlet.
- Confirm the inlet is primed.
- Check for a partially closed valve.
- Confirm the liquid temperature is within the model's operating range.

### Severe leakage, sparks or smoke

Stop using the equipment and request human technical support. The AI assistant must not guide the customer through internal electrical repair.

## 7. Maintenance

Perform a visual inspection every 250 operating hours. Check external seals, fasteners, cables and signs of leakage or overheating. Internal service must be performed by qualified service personnel.

## 8. Warranty claim information

To begin a warranty review, collect:

- model;
- serial number;
- proof of purchase;
- installation date;
- description of the issue;
- photos or video when safe to obtain.

Submitting information does not guarantee warranty approval. A human representative must confirm coverage.

## 9. Shipping note

Standard in-stock orders are normally prepared for shipment within 7–12 business days after order confirmation. This is an estimate only. The manual does not authorize the AI assistant to guarantee stock, shipping or delivery dates.
